record_title: Exact central codimensions for the transpose superinvolution on M2
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The identity basis, full codimension summation, cocharacters, and central-polynomial generators for the transpose superinvolution are prior work, as is the general theory of central and proper-central codimension exponents for superalgebras with superinvolution. The novelty claim is restricted to the exact central-binomial closed forms for the full and central codimensions, the central-layer multiplicities, and the asymptotic one-quarter/three-quarter split for this algebra. For DOI 10.4153/S0008439525101276 and DOI 10.1007/s00209-025-03689-8, abstracts and indexed descriptions were inspected but complete article text was not, leaving a residual special-case-coverage risk; the 2026 source preprint may also be revised. No independent validation is asserted.
